_doc: Cursor's orchestrate plugin: a root planner decomposes a goal into tasks that isolated workers, subplanners, and verifiers take, talking upward through handoff files in git. The loop (scripts/) calls the Cursor SDK; those files are ports that a harness adapter replaces. Tickets are optional inputs the root planner reads. cursor-sdk is excluded because it documents the Cursor SDK the ports replace; upstream's tests are ignored until the adapter brings its own.

extra_needs.uses: The Andon stop signal and the run thread mirror go through Slack reactions and messages; the loop works without Slack.
extra_needs.question: Does the harness have a team-chat channel the loop can mirror to and read a stop signal from?
extra_needs.fallback: Keep the text; Slack is optional. Say how the harness's adapter carries the stop signal without it (the Amp adapter reads `andon.json` in the root workspace).

ports.name: agent-runtime
ports.interface: Over the harness: spawn, getRun, wait, stream, cancel, list, sendFollowUp, agentUrl. Exports the installed files import from these port files at runtime, which the adapter must keep under these names: `AgentManager` and the type `RespawnSource` from core/agent-manager.ts (cli/util.ts; core/loop.ts imports the type), `appendAgentFooter` from core/agent-manager.ts (cli/andon.ts, cli/comments.ts), `registerTaskCommands`, `registerInspectCommands`, and `registerForensicsCommands` from cli/task.ts, cli/inspect.ts, and cli/forensics.ts (cli/index.ts), `GITHUB_FOLLOWUP_NOTE` from core/github-followups.ts (cli/task.ts and core/prompts.ts), and the SDK type names `Run` and `SDKAgent` (schemas.ts) and `RunResult` (core/handoff.ts) from core/runtime.ts, where the set's transforms point the former `@cursor/sdk` imports.

ports.name: models
ports.interface: models, probe. Exports the installed files import at runtime: `renderModelCatalog` from models.ts (core/prompts.ts); the port's own cli/task.ts and tools/probe-models.ts also use `MODEL_CATALOG`, `ModelProfile`, `defaultModelForType`, `isKnownModel`, and `resolveModelSelection`.
